patterns: what is the name of the college
responses: The full name is **St. Philomena College (Autonomous), Puttur**. It is managed by the Catholic Board of Education (CBE) and is ISO 9001:2015 Certified. It has been Re-Accredited by NAAC at 'A' Grade.

St. Philomena College was founded in **1958** by **Msgr. Antony Patrao**. He envisioned a college in this part of Karnataka to save people from traveling to distant places for higher education. The college has since grown into a reputed autonomous institution.

The institution is committed to the holistic development of students — academically, culturally, and spiritually — to produce responsible citizens. For detailed vision and mission, visit: https://spcputtur.ac.in/the-institution/vision-and-mision
